ai_review.summary: Tinny‑sounding matrix recording, but a very good show with solid playing throughout
ai_review.review: The only technical gripe is a slightly tinny processing treatment that colors the sound, likely due to the matrix source. Musically the concert is praised as very good, with consistently solid performances from the band. Overall it’s an enjoyable listening experience despite the modest audio flaws.

ai_rating.rationale: One detailed 4‑star review highlights a good musical performance (70% weight) and notes minor recording issues (30% weight), leading to an overall rating of about four stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Processing sounds a bit tinny; overall clarity is acceptable but not pristine.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Consistently solid playing throughout the show, no major dips noted.
